content.short: Phala Network is a decentralized AI compute cloud providing private execution via secure TEE hardware enclaves.
content.description: Phala Network is an innovative decentralized cloud computing platform designed to provide a secure and confidential execution layer for Web3 AI and privacy-sensitive applications. By utilizing Trusted Execution Environments (TEE)—secure hardware enclaves—the network enables developers to process sensitive data without exposing it to the underlying infrastructure or the internet. This ensures total data privacy while maintaining high-performance compute capabilities. Originally a Polkadot parachain, Phala has evolved into a high-throughput Ethereum Layer 2 to serve the AI economy.
